title: AI Gaming Festival: Assasins Creed Game Director + Core Loops
author: bingewavecinema
selftext:
Starting to ramp up for the AI Gaming Festival next month, I've put together some REALLY good speakers ranging from VCs if you are try to raise money from AI experts from Take-Two Interactive.

One of the speakers is Martin Capel, one of the game directors Assassins Creed and also worked on Fortnite, and he is going to on developing core loops and how Ai can assist with the process.

[RSVP Here For His Session](https://www.glitch.fun/gameshows/9eadde86-a1b2-4882-86e4-a3e9e2e08814/schedule/019fa978-7e82-72c7-b9f2-a1b7e5287d08/standalone)

RSVP Early while tickets free, once they hit September, early bird free tickets end.

I think Martin's talk is very important because I see a lot games being graphically developed well, but missing the core loop, or the "point" of the game.
